recommendation.headline: Spotify should focus product effort on usability in the next quarter due to overwhelming user complaints regarding premium paywalls.
recommendation.rationale: Usability ranks as the highest priority issue with a priority score of 225, driven by a massive complaint count of 80 and a severity sum of 225 (C1, C2, C4). Users frequently express intense frustration that recent updates restrict core features behind paywalls, rendering the app less enjoyable or nearly useless as seen in reviews like 11ad400f-4487-4dfa-a9da-c8d624f4f107 and 21915fcd-9a35-48ba-b277-6296c4154603. While other areas have higher individual mean severities, usability demands immediate attention to curb widespread dissatisfaction.

alternatives.why_not: Although playback errors have a higher mean severity of 3.552632, its priority score of 135 is lower than usability's top-ranked score (C5, C7, C8).
Billing issues account for a lower priority score of 85 compared to the overwhelming volume of usability complaints (C9, C12).
Access issues have a much lower complaint count of 14 and a smaller priority score of 54 (C21, C24).

recommendation.limitations: These findings rely on self-selected historical reviews submitted by users during the review window. The feedback reflects expressed intent and complaints rather than definitive behavioral churn metrics. Additionally, the data represents partial months of tracking.
